task.subject: Ontology cross-pillar grant kernel slice
task.description:
Task: cs-ontology-cross-pillar-grant-kernel-fd001-alignment.
Use existing worker-3 ontology worktree /Users/jasonlee/oyatie-worktrees/fd001-worker3-ontology-schema-revision-20260520T122217Z after completed task 27 commit 1e2ebe9e. This lane is disjoint from worker-1 mail and worker-2 messenger runtime-binding work.
Scope: crates/oya-ontology-kernel/src/pillar.rs plus exact evidence paths evidence/fd001/cs-ontology-cross-pillar-grant-kernel-fd001-alignment-* and evidence/multispectrum/cs-ontology-cross-pillar-grant-kernel-fd001-alignment.json only. No root manifests, contracts, registries, adapters, Cedar policy files, or I/O.
Before editing read authority/context: specs/root-hub-pointers.json, docs/AGENTS.md, specs/masterplan.json, specs/master-plan-sequencing.json, microservices/ontology/IP-013-pillar-cross-pillar-grant.md, microservices/ontology/policy/type-isolation.md TI-11..TI-13, current crates/oya-ontology-kernel/src/pillar.rs, and one similar pure guard/state-machine pattern in the repo. Run planning-closure start gate. Claim with Oya VCS as worker-3 intent "FD001 ontology cross-pillar grant kernel" for crates/oya-ontology-kernel/src/pillar.rs::CrossPillarGrant.
Implement pure kernel model for cross-pillar grant issuance/use: principal id, source/target pillars, data-class cap label, expires_at_epoch_seconds with <=30 day max duration, signed_by exactly two distinct non-empty principals not equal to subject principal, issued_at/now validation, no same-pillar grant needed/allowed, expired grant refused, target pillar must match allowed target, deterministic errors, and a guard function/trait that denies cross-pillar read without a valid grant and permits with a valid unexpired grant. Keep it std-only and framework-free. Tests: same-pillar allowed without grant, cross-pillar denied without grant, two-person valid grant permits, one signer rejected, duplicate signer rejected, signer equal principal rejected, >30d rejected, expired rejected, wrong target pillar rejected, invalid labels rejected.
Verify: cargo fmt --all --check; cargo test -p oya-ontology-kernel -- --nocapture; cargo nextest run -p oya-ontology-kernel; cargo clippy -p oya-ontology-kernel --all-targets -- -D warnings; planning-closure; data-class; architecture-boundaries; catalog; dependency-seam; scoped oya git diff --check; Oya VCS verify/done/promote. Commit only scoped pillar/evidence with Lore trailers.
